發佈時間：16:08 2026-11-16 HKT

Nvidia（輝達，又稱英偉達）創辦人黃仁勳辭任行政總裁後，引發公司內部震盪。一名駐上海的資深機械人工程師昨日（15日）在社交平台發長文宣布離職，直言黃仁勳塑造的工程文化是其留任關鍵，不滿高層未作充分解釋便倉促換帥，帖文獲逾10萬人讚好。

讚揚黃仁勳親讀員工電郵

據《商業內幕》（Business Insider）等外媒報道，在Nvidia上海機械人部門任職逾一年的資深研究工程師達瑞爾（Darrell Dai），於社交平台X發布離職聲明，吸引逾560萬次瀏覽及逾10.4萬人讚好。

I’ve decided to leave NVIDIA. There are a few things I want to say. As a robotics engineer at NVIDIA, I have seen Jensen as much more than the company’s CEO. I admire his willingness to invest in a future that was not yet obvious. He committed to CUDA long before the deep learning boom and positioned NVIDIA for AI before it became everyone’s priority. Those decisions helped build the infrastructure that powers today’s AI. I have seen that same vision in physical AI: investing in robotics, sharing open-source tools and projects, and building computing platforms that bring AI into the physical world. This is the work I do every day—and a future I believe in. But what matters most to me is the culture he helped build. Engineers are encouraged to explore, take risks, and learn from mistakes. Jensen reads employees’ Top 5 emails, follows their work, and engages directly. In a company this large, that connection matters. It makes an individual engineer feel that their ideas can still be heard. That is why this has been so disappointing. I do not have all the facts surrounding the allegations, and I cannot prejudge the investigation. My admiration for Jensen does not put him above scrutiny. What I find difficult to accept is having to come to terms with his departure before receiving an explanation that helps me understand it. What this means for our direction, our culture, and the people doing the work remains unclear to me. I have felt that engineers’ perspectives matter here. On this decision, I have not felt heard. That gap has been more painful than I expected. I understand that some information cannot be shared immediately. But that does not erase the feeling of being left outside a decision that affects the company we help build every day. A company’s greatness comes from its leadership, its governance, and the people who turn its ambitions into reality. Employees’ trust and sense of belonging are part of that, too. Jensen’s vision and the engineering culture he shaped were important reasons I wanted to stay. His departure led me to decide that my own chapter here should also come to a close. I leave with sadness and gratitude. The colleagues I have worked with, and the work we believed in together, will always matter to me. These are my personal views.

— Darrell Dai (@darrell_dai) November 15, 2026

達瑞爾表示，黃仁勳在深度學習熱潮興起前便投入CUDA技術布局人工智能（AI），近年更積極發展機械人、開源工具與實體AI，其遠見與一手建立的工程文化是吸引他留下的重要原因。

達瑞爾指出，黃仁勳鼓勵工程師大膽探索、冒險並從錯誤中學習，更會親自閱讀員工的「Top 5」工作電郵，並直接追蹤進度及互動，令基層工程師感到意見獲高層重視。

基層工程師感到受重視

他坦言不清楚針對黃仁勳的所有指控是否屬實，亦不認為對方可凌駕監督調查，但難以接受管理層在未向員工提供合理解釋前便決定讓創辦人離任，感嘆「我們的聲音沒有被聽見，這種落差感比想像中更痛苦」，遂決定隨黃仁勳離去而結束在Nvidia的職涯。

黃仁勳於本月12日因承認婚外情及接受內部審查而閃電辭職，目前Nvidia董事會正物色新任行政總裁。雖然Tesla行政總裁馬斯克（Elon Musk）等矽谷領袖推動聯署，質疑黃仁勳遭董事會「逼退」並促請交代；惟華爾街與華府政界態度強硬，機構Yorkville資深董事總經理艾夫斯（Dan Ives）直言，考慮到華府審查與道德準則，讓黃仁勳回任的想法「荒謬至極」；美國參議員沃倫（Elizabeth Warren）亦強調，辭職並不能免除Nvidia或黃仁勳的潛在國安與法律責任。
